factorybot_buchi_reward_tradeoff.description: FactoryBot matched-reward shielding quality, based on the paper's Figure 4b/Figure 5 visual estimates at the epsilon=0.4 reward-gap operating point. The paper reports the proposed shield achieving much higher Buchi frequency than the naive exploratory shield while staying within the same reward-closeness condition.

buchi_frequency.description: Mean frequency of visits to the required Buchi region; this is the paper's headline liveness benefit.

reward_gap_to_nominal.description: Mean drop in average reward relative to the unshielded nominal policy, measuring the reward-preservation constraint.

buchi_frequency_gain_over_naive.description: Mean Buchi-frequency improvement over the naive exploratory shielding baseline at the same evaluation slice.

worst_category_buchi_frequency.description: Lowest category-level Buchi frequency across FactoryBot Close/Far groups, catching methods that improve only one regime.

worst_category_buchi_gain_over_naive.description: Lowest category-level Buchi-frequency gain over the naive baseline, checking that the advantage generalizes across regimes.

reward_budget_violation_rate.description: Fraction of evaluated instances exceeding the reward-gap budget, catching methods that hide constraint failures in the mean.
